checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'performance-readout'.

checks.description: Read is measured against the strategy-artifact success_metric.
checks.rule: Body restates and measures against the success_metric set in the strategy-artifact, and stops-and-asks if it is absent, never inventing a metric after the fact.

checks.description: What works and what does not each carry evidence.
checks.rule: Body requires every what_works and what_does_not_work claim to carry a number with its source and window.
Body states no vanity metrics and names examples (impressions, raw reach, follower count) that do not substitute for the success_metric.

checks.description: Optional supporting cuts are anchored to the success_metric and never replace it or add vanity metrics.
checks.rule: Body and template offer an optional supporting-cuts section (a funnel-stage view and a per-segment cut drawn from the strategy-artifact segments) that supports the success_metric, never replaces it, and never reintroduces vanity metrics (impressions, raw reach, follower count) as a result.

checks.description: Optimization moves are proposals through the human gate.
checks.rule: Body frames every proposed_optimization as a human-gate proposal and states the skill never pauses, shifts budget, or changes a send on its own.
templates/performance-readout.md exists and contains success_metric, results, what_works, what_does_not_work, and proposed_optimizations sections.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the skill files.
checks.rule: No file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash character.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) appear in any file; digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in any Arabic text.
checks.rule: No file contains the U+0640 tatweel character.
